Psi-Emitter Activation!: The last Emission created several teleportation anomalies leading to this strange location. It appears spatial anomalous spheres, or something similar, recently transported fragments of buildings, ruins, forests, and clearings here. Lonely high-rises in open fields, roads leading nowhere, and numerous other oddities await stalkers! A 1v1 location map. Fully mirrored balance - both sides have identical starting conditions. This scenario has no turn limit. You must capture the entire location.
